title: LUCA: A Synthetic World for Experimental Reasoning
title_zh: LUCA：一个用于实验推理的合成世界

paragraphs.en: 提出合成世界LUCA,在已知真值下分别评估LLM智能体的实验选择、预测、诊断与干预能力。 An experimental agent can succeed for the wrong reasons. Evaluations, however, often focus on the outcome, not the experiments, evidence, and inferences that produced it. We introduce LUCA, a configurable synthetic world for evaluating this process under fully known ground truth. Agents learn unknown regulatory systems through budgeted experimentation, then predict unseen interventions, diagnose hidden faults, and attempt rescues. This setup allows us to evaluate experiment selection, prediction, diagnosis, and intervention separately. Across seven frontier LLMs and three baselines, these capabilities dissociate sharply. Agents frequently rescue malfunctioning systems while diagnosing the wrong fault; diagnosis varies 7x across models while prediction varies only 1.4x. Models also adopt surprisingly different experimental strategies, and greater exploration does not reliably yield better performance. In one failure mode, agents often perform the experiment needed to distinguish competing causes, but still fail to use the resulting evidence. LUCA turns these hidden failures into measurable behaviours, providing a controlled environment to study where experimental agents succeed and fail. Code: https://github.com/RelationRx/luca.
paragraphs.zh: 提出合成世界LUCA，在已知真值下分别评估LLM智能体的实验选择、预测、诊断与干预能力。一个实验智能体可能因错误的原因而成功。 然而，现有评估往往只关注结果，而不是产生该结果的实验、证据和推理。 我们提出LUCA，一个可配置的合成世界，用于在完全已知的真值下评估这一过程。 智能体通过预算受限的实验来学习未知的调控系统，然后预测未见过的干预、诊断隐藏的故障，并尝试实施挽救。 这一设置使我们能够分别评估实验选择、预测、诊断和干预能力。 在七个前沿LLM和三个基线方法上，这些能力表现出显著的分离。 智能体经常在诊断出错误故障的情况下成功挽救故障系统；诊断能力在不同模型间相差7倍，而预测能力仅相差1.4倍。 各模型还采用了差异惊人的实验策略，且更多的探索并不总能带来更好的表现。 在一种失败模式中，智能体通常能够执行区分相互竞争的成因所需的实验，但仍然未能利用由此得到的证据。 LUCA将这些隐藏的失败转化为可测量的行为，提供了一个受控环境来研究实验智能体在何处成功、在何处失败。 代码：https://github.com/RelationRx/luca。
